seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [player,portal] show mixed outcomes: no_change x2, w,x,y x1, h,w,x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Background from frame colours: 1 floor, 15 wall for player only, 2 wall for all, 4 socket borders (passable) and HUD row 63.
Kick: player next rect overlapping a block slides it 3/tick with push_chain closure; group stops on colour 2/edge/player/non-fitting socket interior (target inset 1); player stays. This decides the block A1 [player,portal] mixed outcomes.
Click on block: player takes its rect; old player stays drawn as a ghost with centre 4. Player edges touching a block drawn 0; block centres 5, player centre 0.
HUD row 63 = ceil(n/2) zeros from right, n = actions this level incl. no-ops; parity is hidden (continuity-gated, fallback n=2*zeros).
Unconfirmed: whether fitting blocks can enter sockets, whether the ghost collides, actions 5/7 (treated as no-op ticks).
